content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-97 identifies this service as bundled into another paid service, with no established patient responsibility; the remaining deductible does not make a contractual bundling adjustment billable to the patient. Records and a necessity appeal have already been submitted, and similar claims show no payment from further submissions or reviews. There is no current denial permitting another appeal or peer-to-peer review, and no documented correction that would overcome the bundling determination, so the remaining balance is not collectible.","action":"write_off"}
